name: Tsurugi Takuma
source:
Division: MWPSB CID Division 1
Occupation: Enforcer
Date of Birth: 05-05-2087

A new Enforcer who was assigned to the Public Safe Bureau's CID Division 1. He is stubborn and short-tempered, but has a strong sense of justice. He leads his life striving to be hardboiled, and though he acts tough around girls, he's gentle at heart.

[From Digital Art Book]
